dealey-plaza.name: Dealey Plaza
dealey-plaza.tip: Come early morning to see the grassy knoll and the X marks on Elm Street without crowds.

sixth-floor-museum.name: The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
sixth-floor-museum.price_text: ≈ USD 25–30 adult · check on the day
sixth-floor-museum.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
sixth-floor-museum.tip: Book a timed ticket online; the audio guide is worth the extra time.

reunion-tower.name: Reunion Tower GeO-Deck
reunion-tower.price_text: ≈ USD 20–30 adult · check on the day
reunion-tower.hours: Daily, usually late morning to evening · check on the day
reunion-tower.tip: Go up just before sunset for daylight and city lights in one visit.

dallas-zoo.name: Dallas Zoo
dallas-zoo.price_text: ≈ USD 18–28 adult · check on the day
dallas-zoo.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
dallas-zoo.tip: Start at the Giants of the Savanna early; animals are most active before the heat.

six-flags.name: Six Flags Over Texas
six-flags.price_text: ≈ USD 50–100 one-day ticket · check on the day
six-flags.hours: Seasonal; usually daily in summer · check on the day
six-flags.tip: It is in Arlington, about 30 minutes by car from Downtown; buy tickets online and arrive at opening.

traders-village.name: Traders Village
traders-village.price_text: ≈ USD 5 parking · entry usually free · check on the day
traders-village.hours: Weekends mainly, morning to late afternoon · check on the day
traders-village.tip: A huge weekend flea market in Grand Prairie; bring cash and go early for parking.

smu.name: Southern Methodist University (SMU)
smu.tip: Walk the tree-lined boulevard and see the George W. Bush Presidential Center next door.

chuck-e-cheese.name: Chuck E. Cheese
chuck-e-cheese.price_text: Pay per game and food · check on the day
chuck-e-cheese.hours: Daily, usually late morning to evening · check on the day
chuck-e-cheese.tip: Good rainy-day stop for young kids; check the nearest branch before you go.

pizza-hut.name: Pizza Hut
pizza-hut.price_text: Budget pizza · check on the day
pizza-hut.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
pizza-hut.tip: Chain pizza; use it as a quick, cheap meal near Downtown rather than a destination.

prairie-playland.name: Prairie Playland
prairie-playland.tip: Small family play spot; confirm location and hours before making the trip.

smoothie-king.name: Smoothie King
smoothie-king.price_text: Budget smoothies · check on the day
smoothie-king.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
smoothie-king.tip: Handy cool drink stop on a hot Dallas afternoon.

wingstreet.name: WingStreet
wingstreet.price_text: Budget wings · check on the day
wingstreet.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
wingstreet.tip: Wings sold through Pizza Hut branches; fine for a quick bite, not a food destination.

itz.name: iT'Z Family Food & Fun
itz.price_text: Buffet plus game credits · check on the day
itz.hours: Daily, usually late morning to evening · check on the day
itz.tip: Buffet and arcade under one roof; good for families with kids on a hot or rainy day.

klyde-warren.name: Klyde Warren Park
klyde-warren.tip: A park built over the freeway between Downtown and Uptown; food trucks often park here at lunch.

dallas-arts-district.name: Dallas Arts District walk
dallas-arts-district.price_text: Free to walk · museums charge entry
dallas-arts-district.tip: Walk between the Dallas Museum of Art, the Nasher and the Crow Museum in one loop.

dallas-museum-art.name: Dallas Museum of Art
dallas-museum-art.price_text: Free general admission · special shows ticketed
dallas-museum-art.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Sun daytime · check on the day
dallas-museum-art.tip: General entry is free; go for the free collection and check what special exhibition is on.

deep-ellum.name: Deep Ellum street walk
deep-ellum.hours: Best in the evening; bars open late
deep-ellum.tip: Murals, live music and barbecue; walk Main Street and look up at the wall art.

bishop-arts.name: Bishop Arts District
bishop-arts.price_text: Free to walk · pay per shop and cafe
bishop-arts.hours: Shops daytime; restaurants into the evening
bishop-arts.tip: Independent shops and cafes a short drive from Downtown; good for a relaxed half-day.

katy-trail.name: Katy Trail
katy-trail.tip: A shaded walking and cycling path through Uptown; rent a bike or just stroll a section.

peggy-suelen.name: Peggy Sue BBQ
peggy-suelen.price_text: ≈ USD 15–25 per person · check on the day
peggy-suelen.hours: Usually lunch and dinner daily · check on the day
peggy-suelen.tip: Classic Dallas barbecue near SMU; try the brisket plate.
